issues.description: The solution adds an extra 'age' attribute to Animal and defines constructors for Animal, Seal, Pig, and Goat that require (String name, int age). The problem statement UML and the template's commented example in Main use single-argument constructors (e.g., Seal("Clarabelle")) and describe Animal as having only a name. This mismatch between the expected single-argument constructors (name only) and the solution's two-argument constructors (name and age) can confuse students and make example instantiations inconsistent.
issues.suggestedFix: Either remove the additional 'age' attribute and the two-parameter constructors from the solution so constructors accept only (String name) as shown in the UML and template examples, or update the problem statement, UML, and template Main examples to include the 'age' attribute and require two-argument constructors (String name, int age). Ensure all example instantiations and class constructors are consistent across problem statement, template, and solution.
